```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>

<style>
  .waza-outer {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 1em 0;
    border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .waza-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;
    background: #5654A2;
    padding: 10px 16px;
  }

  .waza-header-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: rgba(248, 247, 240, 0.2);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .waza-header-icon svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .waza-header-text {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  /* Outer 2-column group layout */
  .waza-groups {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
  }

  .waza-group {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .waza-group:nth-child(odd)  { border-right: 1px solid #D4D3EE; }
  .waza-group:nth-child(-n+2) { border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE; }

  /* Section bars */
  .waza-section-bar {
    padding: 7px 16px;
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75em;
    font-weight: bold;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .waza-designing  .waza-section-bar { background: #E8E7F5; color: #7B79BE; }
  .waza-solving    .waza-section-bar { background: #D8EDD8; color: #527852; }
  .waza-expressing .waza-section-bar { background: #F0D8D8; color: #906060; }
  .waza-growing    .waza-section-bar { background: #F0E0C8; color: #906040; }

  /* Card grids — 2 cards per group */
  .waza-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    flex: 1;
    border-top: 1px solid;
  }

  .waza-designing  .waza-grid { background: #F4F3FA; border-color: #D4D3EE; }
  .waza-solving    .waza-grid { background: #EEF6EE; border-color: #C0DCC0; }
  .waza-expressing .waza-grid { background: #FAF0F0; border-color: #E0C0C0; }
  .waza-growing    .waza-grid { background: #FAF4EC; border-color: #E0CCA8; }

  .waza-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 18px 16px;
    text-align: center;
    border-right: 1px solid;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .waza-designing  .waza-card { border-color: #D4D3EE; }
  .waza-solving    .waza-card { border-color: #C0DCC0; }
  .waza-expressing .waza-card { border-color: #E0C0C0; }
  .waza-growing    .waza-card { border-color: #E0CCA8; }

  .waza-card:last-child { border-right: none; }

  .waza-designing  .waza-card:hover { background: #ECEAF5; }
  .waza-solving    .waza-card:hover { background: #E2F0E2; }
  .waza-expressing .waza-card:hover { background: #F4E4E4; }
  .waza-growing    .waza-card:hover { background: #F4EAD8; }

  .waza-card-icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .waza-designing  .waza-card-icon { background: #DDDCF0; }
  .waza-solving    .waza-card-icon { background: #C8E0C8; }
  .waza-expressing .waza-card-icon { background: #E8CCCC; }
  .waza-growing    .waza-card-icon { background: #E8D0A8; }

  .waza-designing  .waza-card:hover .waza-card-icon { background: #F4F3FA; }
  .waza-solving    .waza-card:hover .waza-card-icon { background: #EEF6EE; }
  .waza-expressing .waza-card:hover .waza-card-icon { background: #FAF0F0; }
  .waza-growing    .waza-card:hover .waza-card-icon { background: #FAF4EC; }

  .waza-card-icon svg {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .waza-designing  .waza-card-icon svg { color: #5654A2; }
  .waza-solving    .waza-card-icon svg { color: #386038; }
  .waza-expressing .waza-card-icon svg { color: #904040; }
  .waza-growing    .waza-card-icon svg { color: #905020; }

  .waza-label {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    line-height: 1.4;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .waza-designing  .waza-label { color: #5654A2; }
  .waza-solving    .waza-label { color: #386038; }
  .waza-expressing .waza-label { color: #904040; }
  .waza-growing    .waza-label { color: #905020; }

  .waza-sub {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75em;
    color: #9B8EA0;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .waza-desc {
    font-size: 0.88em;
    color: #564232;
    line-height: 1.5;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .waza-groups { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .waza-group:nth-child(odd)  { border-right: none; }
    .waza-group:nth-child(-n+2) { border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE; }
    .waza-group:last-child      { border-bottom: none; }
    .waza-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .waza-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: left;
      border-right: none;
      border-bottom: 1px solid;
      padding: 14px;
      gap: 0 12px;
    }
    .waza-card:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .waza-card-icon { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / -1; margin-bottom: 0; align-self: center; }
    .waza-label { grid-column: 2; margin-bottom: 1px; }
    .waza-sub   { grid-column: 2; margin-bottom: 1px; }
    .waza-desc  { grid-column: 2; margin-top: 0; }
  }
</style>

<div class="waza-outer">
  <div class="waza-header">
    <div class="waza-header-icon"><i data-lucide="wand-2"></i></div>
    <span class="waza-header-text">Waza Skills</span>
  </div>

  <div class="waza-groups">
    <div class="waza-group waza-designing">
      <div class="waza-section-bar">Designing</div>
      <div class="waza-grid">
        <div class="waza-card">
          <div class="waza-card-icon"><i data-lucide="lightbulb"></i></div>
          <div class="waza-label">/think</div>
          <div class="waza-sub">Before building</div>
          <div class="waza-desc">Validates architecture before writing code.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="waza-card">
          <div class="waza-card-icon"><i data-lucide="pen-tool"></i></div>
          <div class="waza-label">/ui</div>
          <div class="waza-sub">Frontend UI</div>
          <div class="waza-desc">Builds UI with a committed aesthetic.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="waza-group waza-solving">
      <div class="waza-section-bar">Solving</div>
      <div class="waza-grid">
        <div class="waza-card">
          <div class="waza-card-icon"><i data-lucide="search"></i></div>
          <div class="waza-label">/hunt</div>
          <div class="waza-sub">Any bug</div>
          <div class="waza-desc">Confirms root cause before any fix.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="waza-card">
          <div class="waza-card-icon"><i data-lucide="shield-check"></i></div>
          <div class="waza-label">/check</div>
          <div class="waza-sub">Before merging</div>
          <div class="waza-desc">Reviews diff and auto-fixes safe issues.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="waza-group waza-expressing">
      <div class="waza-section-bar">Expressing</div>
      <div class="waza-grid">
        <div class="waza-card">
          <div class="waza-card-icon"><i data-lucide="file-text"></i></div>
          <div class="waza-label">/read</div>
          <div class="waza-sub">Any URL or PDF</div>
          <div class="waza-desc">Fetches any URL or PDF as clean Markdown.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="waza-card">
          <div class="waza-card-icon"><i data-lucide="pencil"></i></div>
          <div class="waza-label">/write</div>
          <div class="waza-sub">Editing prose</div>
          <div class="waza-desc">Rewrites prose to sound natural.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="waza-group waza-growing">
      <div class="waza-section-bar">Growing</div>
      <div class="waza-grid">
        <div class="waza-card">
          <div class="waza-card-icon"><i data-lucide="book-open"></i></div>
          <div class="waza-label">/learn</div>
          <div class="waza-sub">New domain</div>
          <div class="waza-desc">Six-phase workflow from source to publish.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="waza-card">
          <div class="waza-card-icon"><i data-lucide="activity"></i></div>
          <div class="waza-label">/health</div>
          <div class="waza-sub">Audit setup</div>
          <div class="waza-desc">Audits setup and flags issues by severity.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  if (typeof lucide !== 'undefined') lucide.createIcons();
</script>
```
